dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi! Are you interested in photography?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! ər juː ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn fəˈtɑːɡrəfi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I'm very interested in taking photos. But I'm not good at it.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪm ˈvɛri ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈfoʊtoʊz. bʌt aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈɡʊd ət ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's OK. We can teach you. What are you good at?
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. wiː kən ˈtiːtʃ juː. ˈwʌt ər juː ˈɡʊd ˈæt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm good at drawing. Look, this is my drawing.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈɡʊd ət ˈdrɔːɪŋ. ˈlʊk, ðɪs ɪz maɪ ˈdrɔːɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Wow! You have a real talent!
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ! juː ˈhæv ə ˈriːəl ˈtælənt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Are you good at drawing, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ər juː ˈɡʊd ət ˈdrɔːɪŋ, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, I'm not. I'm only good at photography!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪm ˈnɑːt. aɪm ˈoʊnli ˈɡʊd ət fəˈtɑːɡrəfi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then you can teach me photography!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː kən ˈtiːtʃ miː fəˈtɑːɡrəfi!
